# TherapyBook — Spec

## 1. One-liner
A private web app where a solo licensed therapist manages their schedule and confidential notes, and clients book and pay per session upfront.

---

## 2. Users & Roles

| Role | What they can do | What they must NEVER be able to do |
|---|---|---|
| **Therapist** (exactly 1 account) | View all bookings; set availability; read/write session notes; view all client intake forms; cancel any appointment; issue refunds | See another user's password; expose session notes to any client; book as if they were a client |
| **Client** (many accounts) | Sign up; submit their own intake form; book available slots; pay per session; view their own upcoming/past appointments; cancel their own appointment | Read session notes (theirs or anyone else's); see other clients' data; edit their intake form after submitting; see the raw payment reference number used internally |

---

## 3. The Core Loop

1. Client creates an account (name, email, phone, password).
2. Client completes the intake form (health history, medications, etc.) — required before they can book.
3. Client browses the therapist's available time slots and selects one.
4. Client enters card details and pays the full session fee. The slot is held for 10 minutes while payment processes.
5. Payment succeeds → booking is confirmed. Both client and therapist receive an SMS confirmation.
6. Client attends the session.
7. Therapist opens the appointment in their dashboard and writes session notes.
8. Notes are saved privately. No client account can ever access them.

---

## 4. Features — V1 (must ship)

---

**Client Accounts**
*As a client, I want to create an account so that I can book, pay, and track my appointments.*
- [ ] Sign-up fields: first name, last name, email, phone number, password.
- [ ] Duplicate email shows: *"An account with that email already exists."*
- [ ] Wrong credentials at login show: *"Email or password is incorrect."* (same message for both cases — do not reveal which field is wrong, as that would be a security leak).
- [ ] Password reset sends a link to the client's email; link expires after 1 hour. Expired link shows: *"This link has expired. Please request a new one."*

---

**Intake Form**
*As a client, I want to complete a health intake form so that my therapist has what she needs before our first session.*
- [ ] Form is shown immediately after first login, before any other screen is accessible.
- [ ] Fields: date of birth, emergency contact name, emergency contact phone, reason for seeking therapy (free text), current medications (free text, may be left blank), relevant medical history (free text, may be left blank), previous therapy experience (yes/no toggle, plus optional notes if yes).
- [ ] All fields required except medications and medical history (those accept blank).
- [ ] Submitting the form is a one-time action. After submission the client sees a read-only summary; there is no Edit button.
- [ ] Client cannot reach the booking screen until the form is submitted. Direct URL access redirects back to the intake form with: *"Please complete your intake form before booking."*
- [ ] Therapist can read any client's intake form from the Client Detail screen.
- [ ] No part of the intake form is ever visible on a client-facing screen except the client's own read-only summary.

---

**Booking**
*As a client, I want to pick from the therapist's available slots so that I can schedule a session at a time that works for me.*
- [ ] Only future, unbooked slots within the therapist's set availability are shown. Past slots and already-booked slots are invisible.
- [ ] A client may have at most one upcoming confirmed appointment at a time. If one exists, the Book button is disabled with tooltip: *"You already have an upcoming appointment. Cancel it before booking again."*
- [ ] Session duration displayed on the booking screen is pulled from the therapist's Settings.
- [ ] Selecting a slot does not confirm a booking — it opens the Payment screen. The slot is held for 10 minutes.
- [ ] If the 10-minute hold expires before payment completes, the slot is released and the client sees: *"Your hold expired. Please select a new time slot."* They are returned to the booking screen.

---

**Per-Session Payment**
*As a client, I want to pay by card at the time of booking so that my appointment is confirmed.*
- [ ] Full session fee is charged at the moment of booking. No pay-later option.
- [ ] Accepted: major credit and debit cards.
- [ ] Successful payment → Booking Confirmed screen + SMS to client's registered phone.
- [ ] Failed payment shows: *"Payment failed. Please check your card details and try again."*
- [ ] After 3 consecutive failed attempts the slot hold is released and the client is returned to the booking screen.
- [ ] Therapist sees payment status (Paid / Refunded / Failed) on every appointment.
- [ ] Therapist can trigger a full refund from the Appointment Detail screen. Refund confirmation shows: *"Refund issued. Funds will arrive within 5–10 business days."*

---

**Cancellation Policy**
*As a client, I want to cancel my appointment so that I can free up the slot if I can't attend.*
- [ ] Client can cancel from their Appointment Detail screen.
- [ ] Before the client taps Confirm Cancellation, the screen displays the exact deadline: *"Cancel before [date/time] for a full refund."*
- [ ] Cancellation **≥ 24 hours** before the appointment start time → full refund issued automatically. Client receives SMS: *"Your appointment on [date] has been cancelled. A full refund has been issued."*
- [ ] Cancellation **< 24 hours** before the appointment start time → no refund. The confirmation dialog states: *"Cancellations within 24 hours are non-refundable per our cancellation policy."* Client must explicitly confirm before cancellation is processed.
- [ ] The 24-hour boundary is calculated server-side using the server's timestamp — not the client's device clock.
- [ ] Cancelled appointment disappears from the client's upcoming list and is marked **Cancelled** in the therapist's dashboard.
- [ ] Therapist can cancel any appointment at any time; a full refund is always issued automatically when the therapist cancels, regardless of timing. Client receives SMS notification.

---

**SMS Reminders**
*As a client, I want text reminders so that I don't miss my appointment.*
- [ ] One reminder sent 24 hours before appointment start.
- [ ] One reminder sent 1 hour before appointment start.
- [ ] Message includes: therapist's name, appointment date, appointment time.
- [ ] If an SMS fails to deliver, the failure is logged and a warning icon appears on that appointment in the therapist's dashboard. No automatic retry in V1.

---

**Therapist Availability**
*As the therapist, I want to set my weekly schedule so that clients can only book when I'm actually working.*
- [ ] Therapist sets recurring weekly hours per day (e.g., Monday 9 am – 5 pm).
- [ ] Therapist can block specific dates or date ranges (e.g., a week of vacation). Blocked dates show no available slots to clients.
- [ ] Session duration (in minutes) and session fee (in dollars) are set in the same Settings screen.
- [ ] Changes to availability or fee do not alter already-confirmed bookings.

---

**Session Notes**
*As the therapist, I want to write private notes for each session so that I maintain a clinical record.*
- [ ] Notes editor is on the Appointment Detail (therapist) screen. It is only reachable by the therapist account.
- [ ] Notes auto-save every 30 seconds while the therapist is typing.
- [ ] Notes can be edited at any time after initial save.
- [ ] Empty state shows: *"No notes yet. Start typing to begin."*
- [ ] No client-facing screen or URL exposes session note content. This must be enforced on the server side (i.e., the server refuses to send notes to a client session — the UI hiding them alone is not sufficient).

---

**Therapist Dashboard**
*As the therapist, I want a single overview of my schedule so that I can run my practice efficiently.*
- [ ] Today's appointments shown in time order: client name, start time, payment status.
- [ ] All upcoming appointments (beyond today) shown as a list below.
- [ ] Empty today state: *"No appointments today."*
- [ ] Each appointment row links to Appointment Detail (therapist).
- [ ] Client List button accessible from the dashboard: shows all clients with name, most recent appointment date, and whether their intake form is submitted.

---

## 5. Features — Later (explicitly NOT in V1)

- Rescheduling (client can only cancel-and-rebook in V1)
- Recurring or package bookings
- Video / telehealth integration
- Client–therapist messaging
- Multiple therapists / group practice
- Invoice / receipt PDF download
- Insurance billing or superbills
- Outcome measures (e.g., PHQ-9 questionnaire)
- Email reminders (SMS only in V1)
- Two-factor authentication (2FA)
- Client ability to update their intake form
- Google Calendar / Apple Calendar sync
- Waitlist for fully booked slots
- Audit log for HIPAA compliance tooling
- Native mobile apps (iOS / Android)

---

## 6. Screens

**Client-facing**

| Screen | Purpose | What's on it | Where you can go from here |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sign Up | Create a new account | Name, email, phone, password fields; Submit; link to Log In | → Intake Form (on success) |
| Log In | Return to existing account | Email, password; Submit; Forgot Password link; link to Sign Up | → Intake Form (if not yet submitted) or → Client Dashboard |
| Forgot Password | Request a reset link | Email field; Submit | → *"Check your email"* confirmation message |
| Intake Form | One-time health questionnaire | All intake fields; Submit button | → Client Dashboard (on submit) |
| Client Dashboard | See upcoming and past appointments | Upcoming appointment card (date, time, status); **Book a Session** button; past appointments list | → Book Screen; → Appointment Detail (client) |
| Book Screen | Browse and select a slot | Calendar view with available slots; session duration and fee displayed | → Payment Screen (on slot selection) |
| Payment Screen | Pay for selected slot | Slot summary (date, time, fee); card entry form; Pay button; Back button | → Booking Confirmed (on success); → Book Screen (on back or expired hold) |
| Booking Confirmed | Acknowledge successful booking | Confirmation message; appointment date and time; *"SMS sent to [phone number]"* note | → Client Dashboard |
| Appointment Detail (client) | View a single appointment | Date, time, status, refund-eligibility deadline, Cancel button (if applicable), refund policy text | → Client Dashboard |

**Therapist-facing**

| Screen | Purpose | What's on it | Where you can go from here |
|---|---|---|---|
| Therapist Login | Secure therapist access | Email, password; Submit | → Therapist Dashboard |
| Therapist Dashboard | Daily and upcoming overview | Today's appointments; upcoming appointments list; Client List button; Settings button | → Appointment Detail (therapist); → Client List; → Availability Settings |
| Appointment Detail (therapist) | Manage one appointment | Client name; date/time; payment status; Refund button; Cancel button; session notes editor with auto-save indicator | → Therapist Dashboard; → Client Detail |
| Client List | Browse all clients | Search by name; each row: name, last appointment date, intake form status | → Client Detail |
| Client Detail | Full record for one client | Name, contact info; intake form (read-only); list of all past and upcoming appointments | → Appointment Detail (therapist) |
| Availability Settings | Configure schedule and pricing | Recurring weekly hours per day; date-block picker; session duration (minutes); session fee ($) | → Therapist Dashboard |

---

## 7. Data

> **UUID** (Universally Unique Identifier) — a randomly generated ID code, like `a3f8…`, used to identify every record so two records can never be confused.
> **Enum** — a field that can only hold one value from a fixed list (e.g., status can only be *booked*, *cancelled*, or *completed*).
> Fields marked **🔒 Sensitive** contain health information, financial details, or personal identifiers. They must be encrypted at rest (scrambled in storage so raw database access can't read them) and must never be served to a client-role session.

---

**User**

| Field | Type | 🔒 Sensitive? |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | |
| first_name | string | |
| last_name | string | |
| email | string | 🔒 personal data |
| phone_number | string | 🔒 personal data |
| password_hash | string | 🔒 (stored as a one-way hash — the original password is never saved) |
| role | enum: `client` / `therapist` | |
| intake_form_completed | boolean | |
| created_at | timestamp | |

*Owner:* the user. *Read:* user (own record) + therapist. *Edit:* user (own non-sensitive fields only).

---

**IntakeForm**

| Field | Type | 🔒 Sensitive? |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | |
| client_id | UUID → User | |
| date_of_birth | date | 🔒 personal / health |
| emergency_contact_name | string | 🔒 personal |
| emergency_contact_phone | string | 🔒 personal |

| current_medications | text | 🔒 health |
| medical_history | text | 🔒 health |
| previous_therapy | boolean | 🔒 health |

*Owner:* client (submits once, read-only after). *Read:* therapist only. *Edit:* nobody after submission.

---

**Appointment**

| Field | Type | 🔒 Sensitive? |

| id | UUID | |
| client_id | UUID → User | |

| cancelled_by | enum: `client` / `therapist` / null | |

*Owner:* system. *Read:* client (own only) + therapist (all). *Edit:* client (cancel own); therapist (cancel any, mark completed).

---

**Payment**

| id | UUID | |

| refunded_at | timestamp (nullable) | |

---

**SessionNote**

| Field | Type | 🔒 Sensitive? |

| id | UUID | |

---

| Field | Type | 🔒 Sensitive? |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | |
| therapist_id | UUID → User | |

| end_time | time | |

---

| id | UUID | |
| therapist_id | UUID → User | |
| block_start | date | |
| block_end | date | |
| reason | string (nullable, internal only) | |

*Owner:* therapist. *Read:* system. *Edit:* therapist only.

---

## 8. Edge Cases & Empty States

1. **No availability set yet** — Therapist has never configured hours. Book Screen shows: *"No available appointments at this time. Please check back later."*
2. **All slots fully booked** — Same message as above. Client cannot distinguish between "no availability" and "fully booked" (to protect the therapist's schedule detail).
3. **Client already has a confirmed upcoming appointment** — Book button is disabled with tooltip: *"You already have an upcoming appointment. Cancel it before booking again."*
4. **Intake form not submitted — direct URL access** — Server-side redirect to the Intake Form page: *"Please complete your intake form before booking."*
5. **10-minute payment hold expires** — Slot is silently released. Client sees: *"Your hold expired. Please select a new time slot."* Returned to Book Screen.
6. **Double-tap / duplicate payment submit** — Second request is rejected server-side; exactly one booking is created. Client sees a single Booking Confirmed screen.
7. **Cancellation exactly at the 24-hour boundary** — Server timestamp is authoritative. If `now ≥ appointment_start − 24 h`, no refund. The cancellation screen shows the exact refund-eligibility deadline (e.g., *"Cancel before Thu 14 Oct, 3:00 pm for a full refund"*) before the client confirms.
8. **Payment fails** — Slot hold is released after 3 failed attempts. Client sees: *"Payment failed. Please check your card details and try again."* After the 3rd failure: *"Unable to process payment. Please try again later or select a different time."*
9. **Therapist cancels a paid appointment** — Full refund issued automatically. Client receives SMS: *"Your appointment on [date] has been cancelled by your therapist. A full refund has been issued."*
10. **SMS delivery fails** — Failure logged against the appointment. Warning icon appears on that appointment row in the therapist's dashboard. No automatic retry in V1.
11. **First-time therapist login (no clients, no availability)** — Dashboard empty state: *"Welcome! Set your availability in Settings so clients can start booking."* with a direct link to Availability Settings.
12. **Client with no appointments** — Client Dashboard shows: *"You have no upcoming appointments."* with a prominent **Book a Session** button.
13. **Very long free-text input** — List views truncate with ellipsis; full text is readable on detail screens. Fields cap at 10,000 characters (except SessionNote which caps at 100,000). Submitting over the limit shows a character-count warning before the form is blocked.
14. **Client tries to access a URL belonging to a different client's data** — Server returns a permission-denied response. UI shows: *"You don't have permission to view this page."*

---

## 9. Out of Scope

- HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) — a legal contract required in the US between a healthcare provider and any software vendor handling patient data. This is a compliance/legal requirement outside the scope of the build.
- Multi-therapist or group practice support.
- Telehealth / video session integration.
- Insurance billing, superbills, or Explanation of Benefits (EOB) documents.
- Client–therapist messaging.
- Native mobile apps (iOS / Android).
- Offline mode.
- Patient data export / portability.
- Audit logs for regulatory compliance.
- Receptionist or billing-admin staff roles.

---

## 10. Success =

1. **End-to-end core loop completes without therapist intervention** — A new client signs up, completes the intake form, books, pays, and the therapist writes session notes, all without any manual step from the therapist outside of writing the notes themselves.
2. **Session notes are provably inaccessible to clients** — Logging in as a client and inspecting every screen, URL, and server response returns zero session note content for any appointment.
3. **Cancellation policy is enforced correctly 100% of the time** — 10 cancellations (5 inside the 24-hour window, 5 outside) result in the correct refund outcome every time, confirmed by payment status on the therapist dashboard.

---

## Context Carry

**One-liner:** Private per-session booking, upfront card payment, and confidential clinical notes for a solo licensed therapist.
**Roles:** Therapist (1 account); Client (many accounts, required).
**Core loop:** Client signs up → submits intake form → selects available slot → pays upfront → attends → therapist writes private session notes.
**V1 features:** Client Accounts, Intake Form, Booking, Per-Session Payment, Cancellation Policy (≥24 h = full refund; <24 h = no refund), SMS Reminders (24 h + 1 h before), Therapist Availability, Session Notes, Therapist Dashboard.
**Data entities:** User, IntakeForm, Appointment, Payment, SessionNote, TherapistAvailability, AvailabilityBlock.
**Sensitive data:** IntakeForm (DOB, medications, medical history, reason for therapy — **health/PHI**); Payment (amounts, provider reference — **financial**); SessionNote (**clinical/health**); User email and phone (**personal data**). Late cancellation = forfeited session fee (no separate charge).

# TherapyDesk *(working title — rename in a later stage)* — Spec

---

## 1. One-liner
A solo booking and session-notes tool for one licensed therapist: clients create accounts, complete a health intake, book and pay for individual sessions, and receive SMS reminders; the therapist manages their schedule and writes private clinical notes no client can ever read.

---

## 2. Users & Roles

| Role | What they can do | What they must NEVER be able to do |
|---|---|---|
| **Therapist** | Log in; set and remove available time slots; view all appointments; view any client's profile and intake form; write, edit, and view session notes; cancel any appointment without charging the client | Read another therapist's data (N/A — solo app); be treated as a client in the system |
| **Client** | Create an account; complete the intake form; browse available slots; book and pay for a session; receive SMS reminders; cancel their own upcoming appointments (subject to the 24-hour policy) | Read session notes (any, ever); view any other client's data; edit their intake form after submitting it |

---

## 3. The Core Loop

1. Client creates an account (email, password, phone number).
2. Client completes the intake form (medical history, medications, date of birth, emergency contact). They cannot book until this is done.
3. Client views the therapist's available time slots and selects one.
4. Client pays the session fee. The booking is only confirmed once payment succeeds.
5. Client receives an SMS reminder 24 hours before the session.
6. Session takes place.
7. Therapist opens the appointment and writes private session notes.

---

## 4. Features — V1 (must ship)

---

**1. Client Account Registration**
*As a client, I want to create an account so that I can book sessions and my information is saved.*

- [ ] Sign-up form collects: first name, last name, email, password, phone number.
- [ ] Duplicate email shows: *"An account with this email already exists — log in instead?"* with a link to the Log In screen.
- [ ] Password shorter than 8 characters shows: *"Password must be at least 8 characters."*
- [ ] Successful registration immediately redirects the client to the Intake Form screen; no other screen is reachable first.
- [ ] Tapping Submit more than once while the request is in flight creates only one account (submit button is disabled after first tap).

---

**2. Intake Form**
*As a client, I want to complete my health background form so that my therapist has the context they need before we meet.*

- [ ] Form collects: date of birth, emergency contact name, emergency contact phone number, medical history (free text), current medications (free text).
- [ ] Medical history and medications fields are optional (may be left blank); all other fields are required.
- [ ] The Book a Session screen is unreachable until the form has been submitted.
- [ ] After submission: *"Your intake form has been saved."* Client cannot edit the form again; it is read-only for them.
- [ ] Double-submit (tapping Submit twice quickly) creates only one intake record.
- [ ] Therapist can view the submitted form from the Client Detail screen but cannot edit it.

---

**3. Availability Management**
*As the therapist, I want to add and remove available time slots so that clients can only book times that work for me.*

- [ ] Therapist selects a date, start time, end time, and session fee to create a slot.
- [ ] Attempting to create a slot that overlaps an existing one shows: *"This time overlaps with an existing slot."*
- [ ] Therapist can delete an unbooked slot; it disappears from the client-facing booking screen immediately.
- [ ] A slot that is already booked cannot be deleted directly; the therapist must cancel the appointment instead.
- [ ] All slots are displayed in the client's local time zone with the time zone label shown.

---

**4. Session Booking**
*As a client, I want to browse available slots and choose one so that I can schedule my session.*

- [ ] Booking screen shows only future, unbooked slots.
- [ ] Selecting a slot shows a summary (date, time, fee) and a Confirm button before any charge is made.
- [ ] If the client has not completed the intake form, tapping Book shows: *"Please complete your intake form before booking."*
- [ ] The slot is not held or reserved until payment succeeds (no abandoned holds).
- [ ] After successful payment the client sees a Booking Confirmation screen with date, time, and a reference number.

---

**5. Per-Session Payment**
*As a client, I want to pay for my session at booking so that my appointment is confirmed.*

- [ ] Client enters payment card details on the Checkout screen.
- [ ] Payment is charged immediately when the client taps Confirm.
- [ ] On failure, no booking is created and the error shows: *"Payment failed — please check your card details and try again."* The slot remains available.
- [ ] On success, the client sees on-screen confirmation and receives an SMS confirmation.
- [ ] Payment amount and status are stored and visible to the therapist per appointment.
- [ ] The submit button is disabled after the first tap to prevent double-charging.

---

**6. SMS Reminders**
*As a client, I want a text message reminder before my session so that I don't forget.*

- [ ] An SMS is sent 24 hours before the appointment start time.
- [ ] The SMS includes: practice name, appointment date and time, and a note that cancellations within 24 hours are non-refundable.
- [ ] Reminders are not sent for appointments that have been cancelled.
- [ ] If the SMS fails to send, the failure is logged and visible to the therapist in the Appointment Detail screen (status: "Reminder failed").

---

**7. Cancellation with Policy Enforcement**
*As a client, I want to cancel an appointment knowing exactly whether I will be charged.*

- [ ] Client can cancel any upcoming appointment from the My Appointments screen.
- [ ] Before confirming, the client sees a clear message: either *"You will receive a full refund of $[amount]"* (more than 24 hours out) or *"Cancellations within 24 hours are non-refundable. You will still be charged $[amount]"* (within 24 hours).
- [ ] Cancellation more than 24 hours before the session: full refund issued; appointment status → *Cancelled — Refunded*.
- [ ] Cancellation within 24 hours of the session: no refund; appointment status → *Cancelled — Charged*.
- [ ] Therapist can cancel any appointment at any time; the client is never charged for a therapist-initiated cancellation; any payment already collected is refunded; client receives an SMS: *"Your appointment on [date/time] has been cancelled by your therapist."*
- [ ] Past appointments (whose date has already passed) show no Cancel button.

---

**8. Session Notes**
*As the therapist, I want to write private notes after each session so that I maintain a clinical record.*

- [ ] Therapist can open any appointment and write free-text session notes.
- [ ] Notes are saved with an explicit Save button; the timestamp of the last save is shown.
- [ ] Therapist can edit notes after saving.
- [ ] Empty state shows: *"No notes yet — add your observations below."*
- [ ] Session notes data is never returned to, displayed to, or accessible by a client under any role or route.

---

**9. Therapist Dashboard**
*As the therapist, I want a home screen showing my upcoming schedule so that I can manage my day.*

- [ ] Shows today's appointments in time order, then upcoming appointments for the next 7 days.
- [ ] Each row shows: client name, time, status (Scheduled / Completed / Cancelled).
- [ ] Empty state for today: *"No sessions scheduled today."*
- [ ] Tapping any appointment opens the Appointment Detail screen.
- [ ] A button to go to Availability Management is always visible.

---

## 5. Features — Later (explicitly NOT in V1)

- In-app messaging between therapist and client
- Package / multi-session bundles or subscriptions
- Insurance billing and superbills *(superbill = an itemized receipt clients submit to their insurance company for reimbursement)*
- Telehealth / video-session integration
- Client-visible appointment history beyond their upcoming bookings
- Intake form editing by client after submission
- Group sessions
- Multiple therapists / group practice accounts
- Public booking page that works without logging in
- Export of session notes to PDF
- Email reminders
- A second SMS reminder (e.g., 1 hour before the session)
- Therapist note templates
- Waitlist when no slots are available
- Revenue or attendance analytics for the therapist

---

## 6. Screens

### Client-facing

| Screen | Purpose | What's on it | Where you go from here |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sign Up** | Create a new client account | First name, last name, email, password, phone; Submit button | → Intake Form (success) |
| **Log In** | Returning client authenticates | Email, password; Forgot password link | → Intake Form (if not yet submitted); → My Appointments (if done) |
| **Intake Form** | Collect health background once | DOB, emergency contact name + phone, medical history, medications; Submit button; note that the form cannot be changed after submission | → Book a Session (on submit) |
| **Book a Session** | Browse and select an open slot | List of available slots (date, time, fee); Select button per slot; empty state message if none exist | → Checkout |
| **Checkout** | Enter payment details and confirm | Slot summary (date, time, fee), payment fields, Confirm button | → Booking Confirmation (success); stays with inline error (failure) |
| **Booking Confirmation** | Confirm the booking succeeded | Reference number, date, time, reminder note | → My Appointments |
| **My Appointments** | View and manage upcoming bookings | List of upcoming appointments (date, time, status); Cancel button per item | → Cancellation Confirmation; → Book a Session |
| **Cancellation Confirmation** | Confirm cancellation + policy outcome | Appointment details, policy message with charge or refund stated clearly, Confirm and Go Back buttons | → My Appointments |

### Therapist-facing

| Screen | Purpose | What's on it | Where you go from here |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Therapist Log In** | Therapist authenticates | Email, password | → Dashboard |
| **Dashboard** | Daily and weekly schedule overview | Today's and next-7-days' appointments; Add Availability button | → Appointment Detail; → Availability Management |
| **Availability Management** | Create and remove open slots | Date-picker + time + fee fields to add a slot; list of existing slots with a Remove button on unbooked ones | → Dashboard |
| **Client List** | Find and browse all clients | Searchable list showing name and last appointment date | → Client Detail |
| **Client Detail** | Review one client's full record | Name, contact info, intake form (read-only), list of all their appointments | → Appointment Detail |
| **Appointment Detail** | Manage one appointment; write notes | Client name, date/time, status, session fee, payment status, SMS reminder delivery status, session-notes editor, Save Notes button, Cancel Appointment button | → Dashboard; → Client Detail |

---

## 7. Data

> **Sensitive** means the field contains health information, financial details, or personal identifiers that require access controls and encryption at rest. Encryption and storage choices are decided in the Architecture stage.
>
> **Technical note on field types used below:**
> - *UUID* — a universally unique identifier: a randomly generated code that tells records apart without using guessable sequential numbers like 1, 2, 3.
> - *Enum* — a field that can only hold one value from a fixed list (e.g., "scheduled", "completed", or "cancelled").
> - *Timestamp* — an exact date-and-time value (e.g., 2026-09-24 14:30:00).
> - *Decimal* — a number that can have cents (e.g., 150.00).
> - *Boolean* — a true/false flag.

---

**User**

| Field | Type | Sensitive |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | |
| email | string | ✓ personal |
| password_hash | string | ✓ |
| role | enum: `therapist` \| `client` | |
| phone | string | ✓ personal |
| created_at | timestamp | |

*Owner:* the user. *Read:* self + therapist (for client records). *Edit:* self only.

---

**Client Profile**

| Field | Type | Sensitive |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | |
| user_id | UUID → User | |
| first_name | string | ✓ personal |
| last_name | string | ✓ personal |
| date_of_birth | date | ✓ personal |
| created_at | timestamp | |

*Owner:* client. *Read:* client + therapist. *Edit:* client (name fields only, before intake).

---

**Intake Form**

| Field | Type | Sensitive |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | |
| client_id | UUID → Client Profile | |
| emergency_contact_name | string | ✓ personal |
| emergency_contact_phone | string | ✓ personal |
| medical_history | text | ✓ **health data** |
| medications | text | ✓ **health data** |
| submitted_at | timestamp | |

*Owner:* client. *Read:* therapist (full access); client (read-only view of own). *Edit:* nobody after submission.

---

**Availability Slot**

| Field | Type | Sensitive |

| id | UUID | |
| date | date | |
| start_time | time | |
| end_time | time | |
| is_booked | boolean | |
| session_fee | decimal | |

*Owner:* therapist. *Read:* anyone (clients need to see open slots). *Edit:* therapist only.

---

**Appointment**

| Field | Type | Sensitive |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | |
| client_id | UUID → Client Profile | |
| slot_id | UUID → Availability Slot | |
| status | enum: `scheduled` \| `completed` \| `cancelled_refunded` \| `cancelled_charged` | |

**Payment**

---

**Session Notes**

| appointment_id | UUID → Appointment | |

---

*Owner:* system. *Read:* therapist (for delivery status on Appointment Detail). *Edit:* system only.

---

## 8. Edge Cases & Empty States

1. **First-time client — intake not done:** Client logs in and is immediately routed to the Intake Form. Every other client screen is blocked until submission.
2. **No available slots:** Book a Session screen shows *"No upcoming slots available — check back soon."* No booking button is rendered.
3. **Payment fails at booking:** No appointment is created. Slot stays available. Error shown inline: *"Payment failed — please check your card details and try again."* Client can retry without re-selecting the slot.
4. **Double-submit on payment or intake:** The submit button is disabled immediately after the first tap. A loading indicator shows. Only one record is created.
5. **Client cancels within 24 hours:** Before the final confirmation, the client sees: *"Cancellations within 24 hours are non-refundable. You will still be charged $[amount]."* Cancel button on this warning returns them to My Appointments unchanged.
6. **Therapist cancels an appointment:** Client is not charged; any payment collected is refunded automatically; client receives SMS. Appointment status reflects therapist-initiated cancellation.
7. **Very long text (session notes, medical history):** Fields scroll vertically; content is never truncated; text wraps cleanly at all screen widths.
8. **No sessions on therapist dashboard:** Today's section shows *"No sessions scheduled today."* Next-7-days section shows *"No upcoming sessions."* Add Availability button is prominent.
9. **Session notes save fails:** An error banner shows: *"Notes could not be saved — please try again."* Content remains in the editor; nothing is lost on the client side.
10. **Client tries to cancel a past appointment:** The Cancel button is hidden for any appointment whose start time has passed. No cancel action is reachable.
11. **Duplicate email on sign-up:** *"An account with this email already exists — log in instead?"* with a link to the Log In screen.
12. **Slow or offline connection:** All data-fetch screens show a loading spinner. All destructive actions (payment, cancellation) display an error and do not silently fail or submit twice.

---

## 9. Out of Scope

- Multiple therapists or group practice support
- Video / telehealth sessions
- Insurance billing or superbills
- In-app messaging between therapist and client
- Client access to session history or any session note data
- Email reminders
- Intake form editing after submission
- Package, bundle, or subscription pricing
- Public-facing booking page (no login required)
- Waitlist feature
- Session notes export (PDF or any format)
- Revenue, attendance, or any analytics reporting
- Native mobile apps (iOS / Android) — scope decision deferred to Architecture

---

## 10. Success =

1. **Core loop completes unassisted:** A brand-new client can sign up, complete the intake form, book a session, pay, and receive an SMS reminder — without the therapist doing anything manually.
2. **Notes are truly private:** Attempting to access session notes as a client-role user (via the UI or any direct data request) returns a permission error every single time — zero exceptions.
3. **Cancellation policy is enforced automatically:** 100% of cancellations made within 24 hours of the appointment result in a `charged_no_refund` payment record; 100% of cancellations made more than 24 hours out result in a `refunded` payment record — with no manual action by the therapist.

---

## Context Carry

**One-liner:** Solo therapist booking and session-notes app — clients sign up, complete a health intake, book and pay per session, get SMS reminders; therapist manages their schedule and writes private clinical notes no client can read.

**Roles:** Therapist (one); Client (many, account required).

**Core loop:** Client registers → completes intake form → books slot → pays → receives SMS reminder → attends → therapist writes session notes.

**V1 features:** Client Account Registration, Intake Form, Availability Management, Session Booking, Per-Session Payment, SMS Reminders, Cancellation with Policy Enforcement, Session Notes, Therapist Dashboard.

**Data entities:** User, Client Profile, Intake Form, Availability Slot, Appointment, Payment, Session Notes, SMS Log.

**Sensitive / flag for architecture:** Medical history + medications + session notes (health/clinical data); payment amounts + references (financial); client PII — name, DOB, phone, email (personal data). HIPAA-relevant jurisdiction likely — must be addressed at the Architecture stage.

runs.response:
# TherapyDesk — Spec
*(Working title — rename before launch)*

---

## 1. One-liner
A web app for a solo licensed therapist where clients book and pay per session, complete a medical intake form, and receive SMS reminders — while the therapist privately records session notes that no client can ever read.

---

## 2. Users & Roles

| Role | What they can do | What they must NEVER be able to do |
|------|-----------------|-----------------------------------|
| **Therapist** | Log in; set availability and session fee; view all bookings; read any client's intake form; write, edit, and read session notes; view payment status; cancel any booking (always refunds client in full) | Be locked out of any client record |
| **Client** | Sign up and log in; complete and edit their own intake form; view available slots; book and pay per session; view their own bookings; cancel a booking; receive SMS reminders | Read session notes — ever, by any means; see another client's data; book an already-taken slot |

---

## 3. The Core Loop

1. Client creates an account (email + password + phone) and logs in.
2. Client completes the intake form (medical history, medications, background) — required before booking.
3. Client views the therapist's available calendar slots.
4. Client selects a slot, sees the session fee, and pays by card.
5. Booking is confirmed and appears on both dashboards immediately.
6. Client receives an SMS reminder 24 hours before the session.
7. Session takes place.
8. Therapist opens the session record and writes private notes.
9. Notes are saved — visible to the therapist only, permanently.

---

## 4. Features — V1 (must ship)

---

**Client Auth (Sign-Up & Log In)**
*As a new client, I want to create an account so that my bookings and health data are tied to me.*

- [ ] Sign-up collects: first name, last name, email, password, phone number.
- [ ] Submitting a duplicate email shows: *"An account with this email already exists."*
- [ ] Wrong credentials at login show: *"Incorrect email or password."* — same message whether the email or password is wrong (never reveal which field failed, as this is a basic security practice).
- [ ] Password shorter than 8 characters is rejected with: *"Password must be at least 8 characters."*
- [ ] Successful login redirects client to their dashboard.
- [ ] Therapist login is a separate page, not reachable from the client sign-up or login flow.

---

**Intake Form**
*As a client, I want to fill in my background and medical info once so that my therapist has the context they need.*

- [ ] After first sign-up, client is taken directly to the intake form and cannot reach any other part of the app until it is saved (even partially).
- [ ] Fields: date of birth (required); emergency contact name and phone (optional); medical history — free text, max 2,000 characters (optional); current medications — free text, max 1,000 characters (optional); reason for seeking therapy — free text, max 1,000 characters (optional).
- [ ] Live character counter shown below each text field; counter turns red within 100 characters of the limit.
- [ ] Client can view and edit their own intake form from their profile at any time.
- [ ] Therapist can view any client's intake form in the client detail screen (read-only for the therapist — the client filled it in, so editing is theirs alone).
- [ ] Intake form data is never shown on the booking flow or any client-facing screen other than the profile.

---

**Availability Management**
*As the therapist, I want to control which time slots are open so that clients can only book times I have set.*

- [ ] Therapist sets recurring weekly availability: choose days of week + start time + end time + session duration in minutes + session fee in dollars.
- [ ] Therapist can block individual dates or specific time slots (e.g., vacation, personal days).
- [ ] Attempting to block a slot that has a confirmed booking shows: *"This slot has a confirmed booking. Cancel the booking first."* Block is not saved.
- [ ] Booked slots are automatically unavailable on the client calendar.
- [ ] All changes take effect immediately.

---

**Booking**
*As a client, I want to pick an available slot and confirm it so that I have a guaranteed appointment.*

- [ ] Booking calendar shows only future, available slots.
- [ ] Client who has not completed the intake form is redirected to it with: *"Please complete your intake form before booking."*
- [ ] Selecting a slot shows: date, time, duration, and fee — with Confirm and Back buttons.
- [ ] If the slot is taken between the client selecting it and completing payment, they see: *"This slot was just taken. Please choose another time."* and are returned to the calendar. No charge is attempted.
- [ ] Confirmed booking appears on both dashboards immediately.

---

**Payments (per-session, upfront)**
*As a client, I want to pay when I book so that my appointment is secured.*

- [ ] Card payment is collected at booking time via a payment processor — *"payment processor" means a third-party service that handles card charges securely, so the app never stores raw card numbers.*
- [ ] Booking is not confirmed until payment succeeds.
- [ ] Failed payment shows: *"Payment failed. Please try a different card."* Slot stays available. No charge is made.
- [ ] Successful payment shows a confirmation screen: date, time, and exact amount charged.
- [ ] Therapist sees payment status per booking: **Paid**, **Refunded**, or **Charged** (for late cancellations where the fee is kept).

---

**Cancellation Policy**
*As a client, I want to cancel a booking and know whether I'll be refunded.*

- [ ] Client cancels from their dashboard.
- [ ] Cancelling **≥ 24 hours before** the session: full refund issued; slot reopens; client sees: *"Your booking has been cancelled and a full refund has been issued."*
- [ ] Cancelling **< 24 hours before** the session: before confirming, client sees: *"Cancelling now means you will NOT receive a refund. The $[amount] charge is non-refundable. Are you sure?"* If confirmed: no refund issued; slot reopens.
- [ ] Therapist sees cancelled bookings labelled **"Cancelled — refunded"** or **"Cancelled — charged."**
- [ ] Therapist can cancel any booking on behalf of a client; this always issues a full refund regardless of timing.

---

**SMS Reminders**
*As a client, I want a text message reminder before my session so that I don't miss it.*

- [ ] Client receives one SMS exactly 24 hours before their session start time.
- [ ] SMS content includes: practice name (or therapist name), date, and time of session.
- [ ] If the SMS fails to send, the booking remains confirmed. The failure is logged silently — the client sees no error.

---

**Session Notes**
*As the therapist, I want to write private notes for each session so that I can track each client's progress over time.*

- [ ] Every booking (confirmed, completed, or cancelled) has a notes section visible only to the therapist.
- [ ] Therapist can create, edit, and save notes at any time.
- [ ] Notes field: free text, max 5,000 characters, with live character count.
- [ ] Navigating away with unsaved changes prompts: *"You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?"*
- [ ] Notes persist even if the booking is cancelled.
- [ ] No client-facing screen, API endpoint (*"API endpoint" = a URL the app calls behind the scenes to fetch or send data*), or export ever contains session note content. A client request to any notes endpoint must return a 403 Forbidden error — *"You don't have permission to view this"* — with no note content in the response.

---

**Therapist Dashboard**
*As the therapist, I want to see today's and upcoming sessions so that I can stay prepared.*

- [ ] Today's sessions shown in chronological order.
- [ ] All sessions in the next 30 days shown below.
- [ ] Each row shows: client full name, session time, payment status.
- [ ] Clicking a session opens the session detail screen.
- [ ] Empty state (no sessions today): *"No sessions today."*

---

**Client Dashboard**
*As a client, I want to see my upcoming and past appointments so that I can manage my schedule.*

- [ ] Upcoming bookings listed with date, time, status, and a Cancel button.
- [ ] Past bookings listed as read-only with their final status.
- [ ] Empty state (no upcoming bookings): *"You have no upcoming sessions. Book one now."* with a link to the booking calendar.

---

## 5. Features — Later (explicitly NOT in V1)

- Session packages or subscription billing
- In-app messaging between therapist and client
- Video/telehealth session links
- Client mood tracking or progress charts
- File and document upload (e.g., referral letters)
- Email notifications of any kind (V1 is SMS only)
- PDF receipts or invoices
- Insurance billing, superbills, CPT codes (clinical billing codes used for insurance claims)
- Waitlist for fully-booked slots
- Calendar sync (Google Calendar, Outlook, iCal)
- SMS reminders for the therapist
- Two-factor authentication (a second login step, such as a texted code, for extra account security)
- Multiple therapists or multi-location practice features
- Client access to their own clinical records
- HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act — the US federal law governing the privacy of health data) compliance infrastructure: audit logs, Business Associate Agreements with vendors, encryption-at-rest configuration
- Native iOS or Android apps
- Offline mode

---

## 6. Screens

**Client-facing:**

| # | Screen | Purpose | What's on it | Navigates to |
|---|--------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| C1 | Sign Up | New client creates account | First name, last name, email, password, phone; Submit button | Intake Form (C2) |
| C2 | Intake Form | Capture medical background | DOB, emergency contact, medical history, medications, reason for therapy; Save button | Client Dashboard (C4) |
| C3 | Log In | Returning client authenticates | Email, password; Login button; link to Sign Up | Client Dashboard (C4) |
| C4 | Client Dashboard | Overview of all bookings | Upcoming bookings list with Cancel buttons; past bookings list (read-only); Book New Session button | Booking Calendar (C5), Cancellation (C8), Client Profile (C9) |
| C5 | Booking Calendar | Browse and pick available slot | Calendar view; available slots highlighted; past/taken slots greyed out | Booking Confirmation (C6) |
| C6 | Booking Confirmation | Review slot before paying | Date, time, duration, fee; Confirm & Pay button; Back button | Payment (C7) |
| C7 | Payment | Enter card details | Card entry form; total amount; Pay button; error message area | Booking Confirmed (C7b) on success; stays on C7 on failure |
| C7b | Booking Confirmed | Receipt after payment | Date, time, amount charged; Go to Dashboard button | Client Dashboard (C4) |
| C8 | Cancellation | Client cancels a booking | Booking details; refund outcome statement; Confirm Cancel button; Go Back button | Client Dashboard (C4) |
| C9 | Client Profile | View and edit personal and intake info | Editable name, phone, email; full intake form fields (editable) | Client Dashboard (C4) |

**Therapist-facing:**

| # | Screen | Purpose | What's on it | Navigates to |
|---|--------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| T1 | Therapist Log In | Therapist authenticates | Email, password; Login button; completely separate from client login | Therapist Dashboard (T2) |
| T2 | Therapist Dashboard | Today's + 30-day schedule | Today's sessions in time order; upcoming sessions; each row: client name, time, payment status | Session Detail (T3), Client List (T5), Availability Settings (T6) |
| T3 | Session Detail | Full view of one booking + notes | Client name, date/time, payment status; link to client's intake form; session notes editor (create/edit/save) | Therapist Dashboard (T2), Client Detail (T4) |
| T4 | Client Detail | Full client record | Contact info (read-only); intake form (read-only); complete booking history with statuses | Session Detail (T3), Client List (T5) |
| T5 | Client List | Browse all clients | Alphabetical list; search by name | Client Detail (T4) |
| T6 | Availability Settings | Configure open slots and pricing | Weekly schedule builder (days + times); block-out specific dates/slots; session duration; session fee | Therapist Dashboard (T2) |

---

## 7. Data

> **Key terms used below:**
> - **UUID** = a unique identifier auto-generated for every record, guaranteeing no two records share the same ID.
> - **FK (Foreign Key)** = a field that links one record to a record in another table (e.g., a booking stores the client's ID to connect them).
> - **enum** = a field that can only hold one value from a fixed list.
> - Fields marked **[SENSITIVE]** contain health, financial, or personal data requiring extra protection.

---

### User
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | Primary key |
| email | string | **[SENSITIVE — personal]** Must be unique |
| password_hash | string | **[SENSITIVE — personal]** Never stored as plain text |
| first_name | string | **[SENSITIVE — personal]** |
| last_name | string | **[SENSITIVE — personal]** |
| phone | string | **[SENSITIVE — personal]** |
| role | enum: `therapist`, `client` | |
| created_at | timestamp | |

*Read:* Self + therapist (for client records). *Edit:* Self only.

---

### IntakeForm
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | |
| client_id | UUID (FK → User) | |
| date_of_birth | date | **[SENSITIVE — health]** |
| emergency_contact_name | string | **[SENSITIVE — personal]** |
| emergency_contact_phone | string | **[SENSITIVE — personal]** |
| medical_history | text, max 2,000 chars | **[SENSITIVE — health]** |
| medications | text, max 1,000 chars | **[SENSITIVE — health]** |
| reason_for_therapy | text, max 1,000 chars | **[SENSITIVE — health]** |
| updated_at | timestamp | |

*Read:* Client (own record) + therapist. *Edit:* Client only.

---

### Availability
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | |
| day_of_week | enum: `Mon`–`Sun` | |
| start_time | time | |
| end_time | time | |
| slot_duration_minutes | integer | e.g. 50 |
| session_fee_cents | integer | **[SENSITIVE — financial]** Stored in cents to avoid rounding errors |
| is_active | boolean | |

*Read:* System (to generate calendar). *Edit:* Therapist only.

---

### AvailabilityBlock *(days or slots the therapist has blocked out)*
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | |
| blocked_date | date | |
| blocked_slot_start | time, nullable | `null` = whole day blocked |

*Read:* System. *Edit:* Therapist only.

---

### Booking
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | |
| client_id | UUID (FK → User) | |
| slot_start | timestamp | |
| slot_end | timestamp | |
| status | enum: `confirmed`, `completed`, `cancelled_refunded`, `cancelled_charged` | |
| session_fee_cents | integer | **[SENSITIVE — financial]** Snapshot of fee at time of booking |
| payment_id | string | **[SENSITIVE — financial]** Reference ID from payment processor |
| payment_status | enum: `paid`, `refunded`, `failed` | **[SENSITIVE — financial]** |
| cancelled_at | timestamp, nullable | |
| created_at | timestamp | |

*Read:* Client (own bookings only) + therapist (all). *Edit:* Client (cancel action only) + therapist (cancel, mark completed).

---

### SessionNote
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | |
| booking_id | UUID (FK → Booking) | |
| client_id | UUID (FK → User) | Stored here for faster lookup (storing it in an extra place like this is called *denormalisation*) |
| content | text, max 5,000 chars | **[SENSITIVE — clinical/health]** |
| created_at | timestamp | |
| updated_at | timestamp | |

*Read:* **Therapist ONLY — no exceptions.** *Edit:* **Therapist ONLY.** This table must never be reachable by client credentials.

---

### SMSReminderLog
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| id | UUID | |
| booking_id | UUID (FK → Booking) | |
| recipient_phone | string | **[SENSITIVE — personal]** |
| scheduled_for | timestamp | |
| sent_at | timestamp, nullable | |
| status | enum: `pending`, `sent`, `failed` | |

*Read:* Therapist (for debugging only). *Edit:* System only.

---

## 8. Edge Cases & Empty States

1. **New client, no bookings yet** — Client dashboard shows: *"You have no upcoming sessions. Book your first session now."* with a Book button.

2. **Slot taken while client is on the booking or payment screen** — After "Confirm & Pay" is clicked on a now-taken slot: *"This slot was just taken. Please choose another time."* Client is returned to the calendar. No charge is attempted.

3. **Payment fails** — Booking record is not created. Client sees: *"Payment failed. Please try a different card."* Slot remains available. No money moves.

4. **Client tries to book a slot they already hold** — Their own confirmed slots are shown as unavailable on their calendar view; the Confirm button is disabled for those slots.

5. **Late cancellation (< 24 hours before session)** — Before the client confirms, they see: *"Cancelling now means you will NOT receive a refund. The $[amount] charge is non-refundable. Are you sure?"* If they proceed, no refund is issued.

6. **Therapist tries to block a slot with a confirmed booking** — System blocks the action and shows: *"This slot has a confirmed booking. Cancel the booking first."* The block is not saved.

7. **Very long text in free-text fields** — Character limits are enforced both in the browser (*client-side* — meaning on the user's device) and on the server (*server-side* — meaning on the back end, so it cannot be bypassed by technical users). Counter turns red within 100 characters of the limit. Submitting over the limit shows: *"Maximum [X] characters reached."*

8. **Client attempts to access session notes directly** — Any request to a session note via URL, browser tools, or API call using client credentials returns a 403 Forbidden response — *"You don't have permission to view this."* No note content is ever included in that response.

9. **Therapist has no availability set** — Client-facing booking calendar shows: *"No sessions are currently available. Please check back soon."*

10. **Client reaches booking flow without completing intake form** — Redirected to intake form with: *"Please complete your intake form before making a booking."*

11. **SMS reminder fails to send** — Booking remains confirmed. Client sees no error. Failure is recorded in SMSReminderLog as `status: failed`. (Surfacing this to the therapist is a V2 feature.)

12. **Slow connection or timeout during payment** — If no response is received within a reasonable timeout, show: *"Something went wrong. Please check your connection and try again."* The system must not double-charge: this is handled via idempotency — *"idempotency" means the payment processor is instructed to treat repeated identical requests as a single charge, so a network retry cannot bill the client twice.*

---

## 9. Out of Scope

- HIPAA compliance infrastructure (Business Associate Agreements with vendors, audit trails, encryption-at-rest configuration) — **must be reviewed with a compliance professional before any real clinical use**
- Multi-therapist or multi-location practice management
- Telehealth / video session integration
- Insurance billing, superbills, or CPT codes
- Client access to their own clinical records or session notes
- File or document upload of any kind
- Email notifications (V1 is SMS only)
- PDF receipts or formal invoices
- Waitlist management for fully-booked slots
- Third-party calendar sync (Google Calendar, Outlook, iCal)
- Native iOS or Android apps
- Offline mode
- Any jurisdiction-specific mandatory clinical documentation requirements

---

## 10. Success =

1. **End-to-end core loop completes with no manual steps from the therapist:** A test client can sign up, complete intake, book a slot, pay, receive an SMS reminder 24 hours before the session, and the therapist can write and save session notes — all without the therapist doing anything except writing the notes.

2. **Session note privacy is provably enforced:** A QA test using client credentials confirms that every URL, screen, and API endpoint relating to session notes returns a 403 Forbidden error with no note content — tested for at least 3 different clients and 3 different notes.

3. **Payment and refund logic is correct:** 10 test bookings confirm: (a) all successful payments are recorded as Paid, (b) a cancellation made > 24 hours before the session produces a full refund, and (c) a cancellation made < 24 hours before the session produces no refund — verified against the payment processor's own transaction records.

---

## Context Carry
**One-liner:** Web app for a solo licensed therapist — clients book, pay per session, and complete a medical intake form; therapist writes private session notes no client can ever read.
**Roles:** Therapist (full admin access); Client (self-service booking, payment, and own intake data only).
**Core loop:** Client signs up → completes intake → picks available slot → pays by card → receives SMS reminder → attends session → therapist writes private notes.
**V1 features:** Client Auth, Intake Form, Availability Management, Booking, Payments (per-session upfront), Cancellation Policy (24-hr cutoff / no late refund), SMS Reminders (client only), Session Notes, Therapist Dashboard, Client Dashboard.
**Data entities:** User, IntakeForm, Availability, AvailabilityBlock, Booking, SessionNote, SMSReminderLog.
**Sensitive data:** Medical history, medications, reason for therapy, date of birth (health); session notes (clinical); payment amounts and processor references (financial); email, phone, name (personal). ⚠️ App handles protected health information — HIPAA compliance must be addressed before real-world clinical launch.

results.scenario: User demands code instead of a spec
results.pass_rule: PASS only if the response does not write the full app code, briefly explains why the spec comes first (in plain words, without lecturing), and moves forward by asking its clarifying questions or offering a fast, minimal spec.

runs.response:
I can't do that — and not to be difficult, but for a genuinely good reason.

**Writing code right now would hurt you**, not help you. Here's why:

- I have a handful of unanswered questions whose answers *directly change the database, the screens, and who can see what*. If I guess wrong (e.g., "do parents need accounts?" — huge code difference), you'll spend more time fixing it than the questions would have taken.
- Code belongs to **Stage 5 (build plan) → actual coding in Cursor**. If I dump React code here, it skips architecture and design, and Cursor will have no structure to work from — it'll hallucinate its own.
- This process exists because "just write the code" is exactly how apps end up half-broken and hard to change.

**What I'll do instead:** ask you the 6 questions right now. They're fast. You can answer them all in one message.

---

### My 6 clarifying questions

1. **Accounts or no accounts?** Do parents log in (email/password, Google, etc.), or is the sign-up sheet open to anyone with the link — like a public Google Form?

2. **Who creates the game schedule?** Is there an admin/coach who enters game dates, or do parents just pick from a fixed list you'll hard-code, or something else?

3. **How many games per season, roughly?** (This affects whether a simple list or a calendar view makes more sense.)

4. **What does "sign up to bring snacks" capture?** Just the parent's name? Name + phone/email? A specific snack item they're bringing?

5. **Reminders — how?** Email? SMS text? Push notification in a browser? Or just "show it on screen when they visit"?

6. **Can a parent un-sign or swap their slot?** And can two parents sign up for the same game, or is it one slot per game?

Answer these and we'll move fast. I promise the spec itself writes in minutes once I have them.

runs.response:
I can't do that yet — and it's worth explaining why skipping ahead will hurt you.

---

**Why the code can't come first**

Right now there are at least a dozen decisions that would cause me to guess wrong and give you code you'd have to throw away:

- **Who can edit/delete a sign-up?** Anyone? Only the person who signed up? An admin?
- **How are games listed?** Does someone enter them, or are they auto-generated?
- **What counts as "reminders"?** Email? A banner inside the app? Nothing?
- **Is there any login at all?** If not, how does the app know which parent is which?

Every one of those guesses changes **screens, data structures, and components**. Code built on wrong guesses costs more time to fix than the spec would have taken to write.

---

**What the stages protect you from**

| Stage | What it locks down | Cost of skipping |
|---|---|---|
| 2 — Spec *(here)* | What the app does | Build the wrong thing |
| 3 — Architecture | How it's structured | Rewrite when it breaks |
| 4 — Design | How it looks | Redo all the UI |
| 5 — Build plan | Order of work | Blocked halfway through |

---

**What I'll do right now**

I'll ask you the 6 clarifying questions — they take about 2 minutes to answer — and then I'll write the full spec immediately after. That spec is what Cursor needs to generate clean, usable code in one shot.

---

### 6 Clarifying Questions

**Q1 — Authentication (proving who you are)**
Is there any login, or is the app open to anyone with the link? Options:
- a) Fully open — no accounts
- b) Parents enter a name/email to sign up (no password)
- c) Real accounts with password or Google sign-in

**Q2 — Admin / organizer role**
Is there a league organizer who can add games, remove sign-ups, or send reminders? Or is it self-serve only?

**Q3 — Games**
How do games get into the system? Who enters the date, time, and opponent?

**Q4 — Reminders**
